```blitzbasic
UDPStreamPort:Int32 udp_stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `udp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream. |

**Returns:** The port the stream receives on.
